fusion_ranked_evidence.title: Self-styled Imam jailed 10 years for defiling 7-year-old boy - GhanaWeb
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: You are here: Home → News → Crime & Punishment → 2026 07 25 → **Article 2044805**. Crime & Punishment of Saturday, 25 July 2026. Konate denied the charge of defiling a child under 16. The Wa High Court has sentenced a 42-year-old self-styled Imam, Ilyasu Konate, to 10 years’ imprisonment with hard labour for defiling a seven-year-old boy in Kabenya, a suburb of Wa. The conviction follows a swift prosecution led by Principal State Attorney Abdul Saeed Shakur, who revealed that the convict exploited his position as a trusted neighbour to commit the crime. On January 17, 2026, Konate lured the victim, the child’s sister, and his own stepdaughter onto his motorbike under the pretext of taking them for a ride. Although Konate denied the charge of defiling a child under 16, claiming no assault occurred, the court rejected his defence. He affirmed that the prosecution will relentlessly pursue offenders to ensure the full rigour of the law is applied, offering the victim’s family long-awaited relief as Konate begins his sentence immediately.

fusion_ranked_evidence.title: The cyclospora outbreak lawsuits have begun - Business Insider
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: # The cyclospora outbreak lawsuits have begun. On July 16, health officials linked shredded lettuce sold at US-based Taco Bell restaurants to the cyclosporiasis outbreak. Taylor Farms, a supplier of Taco Bell, said last week it was recalling its iceberg lettuce sourced from Mexico. An Ohio man filed the first lawsuit against Pacific Bells, one of the largest Taco Bell franchises in the country, in a federal court on July 16. The complaint says the man ate two meals at a North Olmsted Taco Bell on June 14 and a third at the same location on June 21, and began to fall ill about a week later. Then, on July 17, a second lawsuit related to the cyclosporiasis outbreak was filed by an Ohio woman. The lawsuit said the man purchased food on June 18 and June 20 from a Taco Bell in Youngstown and fell sick a few days later.

fusion_ranked_evidence.title: Siri Settlement Approved: Apple to Pay Owners of Some iPhone Models - MacRumors
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: # Siri Settlement Approved: Apple to Pay Owners of Some iPhone Models. In May, Apple agreed to pay $250 million to settle a U.S. class action lawsuit over Siri AI's delayed launch, and eligible iPhone users could receive up to a $95 payout. Apple's settlement has now received preliminary approval from a judge, according to a July 17 court document. In March 2025, Apple delayed the launch of the personalized version of Siri, leading to the company being hit with a class action lawsuit alleging false advertising. In a statement, Apple touted a range of other Apple Intelligence features it had already released. iOS 27 should be released in September, at which point "Siri AI" will finally be available to all users with an iPhone 15 Pro or newer. To be eligible to submit a claim, you must reside in the U.S. and have purchased any iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 16 model between June 10, 2024 and March 29, 2025.
